label: Every being contingent at w has esse distinct from its essence
paraphrase: OPEN modal bridge (B6, contrapositive form), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate contingent at w (existing at w, absent at some accessible world) has a represented esse distinct from its represented essence. With excluded middle it is equivalent to: whatever exists at w with esse not distinct from essence exists at every world accessible from w (controls, law 1). Essence-esse identity alone carries no modal force: in the brute-first model a being with esse not distinct from essence is contingent (controls, model 1).
